_how: Weekly routine publishes the first entry with status 'pending'. Entries are chosen for realistic ranking: Data for SEO (US) volume >= 300/mo and keyword difficulty <= 20, page-1 SERP with several small/weak sites, topical fit with an existing pillar post; GSC clusters from tools/data/gsc-queries.json are a tiebreaker. Before writing, re-check the entry's numbers with Data for SEO and swap to a better close variant if one exists. When fewer than 4 entries are pending, research and append new ones the same way. Never target an existing post's exact primary keyword.
